name: deep_clean_system
description: Full Windows cleanup: temp, prefetch, recycle bin, caches, DNS
task_prompt:
Write a Python script to perform a FULL Windows system cleanup. Print a section header before each step and MB freed after each.

Step 1 — TEMP FILES
  Delete all files/folders in os.environ['TEMP'] and C:\Windows\Temp.

Step 2 — PREFETCH
  Check ctypes.windll.shell32.IsUserAnAdmin().   If admin: delete *.pf in C:\Windows\Prefetch. Else skip with warning.

Step 3 — RECYCLE BIN
  ctypes.windll.shell32.SHEmptyRecycleBinW(None, None, 0x0007)

Step 4 — BROWSER CACHES
  Chrome: %LOCALAPPDATA%\Google\Chrome\User Data\Default\Cache
  Edge:   %LOCALAPPDATA%\Microsoft\Edge\User Data\Default\Cache
  Use shutil.rmtree on each; skip if path not found.

Step 5 — DNS CACHE
  subprocess.run(['ipconfig', '/flushdns'])

Step 6 — WINDOWS UPDATE CACHE
  Delete contents of C:\Windows\SoftwareDistribution\Download\   (requires admin; skip gracefully if not).

Step 7 — THUMBNAIL CACHE
  Delete files in %LOCALAPPDATA%\Microsoft\Windows\Explorer\ matching thumbcache_*.db

At the end print a grand total: 'TOTAL FREED: X.XX MB' and a per-step table.
Always skip locked files with PermissionError — never crash.
